run_cython_criteo_kaggle: run the cython_criteo script to preprocess a kaggle dataset from a raw text file into an npz file
run_cython_criteo_terabyte: run the cython_criteo script to preprocess a terabyte dataset with memory mapping enabled
run_loadDataset: run the loadDataset function to preprocess training data with a specified max index range and sub sample rate
review_argparse_parser: review the argparse parser configuration for the Criteo dataset preprocessing CLI arguments
refactor_loadDataset_call: refactor the loadDataset call to support additional dataset types beyond kaggle and terabyte
